_note: Strum glyphs: ▼ = downstroke, ▲ = upstroke, · = muted/skipped beat. Each pattern is 8 sixteenth/eighth-note cells per bar (matches the mockup's 8-glyph rows). tempoBpm is the CLICK the pattern plays against — see feels.json for how Fast Punk/Half-Time share one master tempo via feel template while Mid-Tempo is independent.
